title: Fuel Tank Capacity — 5.2L 32V Ti-VCT
introduction:
I find the engine name in the table before looking at the capacity column. Several engines share an entry here, so read the complete engine label rather than choosing by row position. The blank general row supplies no separate capacity. Keep the gallon and litre figures paired with their printed units.

This is a useful size label for the tank, but the fuel system has more to tell you than its appetite. Capacity alone cannot establish the current fuel level or whether delivery to the engine is correct. This reference does not teach a fuel-system test or repair.

edits.why: The complete engine label establishes applicability, including engines grouped under a common specification. Read the existing table directly for the capacity and units.
